scheme_name: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
overview: The National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities is a welfare-based scholarship scheme under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aimed at providing financial support to students with disabilities for pursuing higher education. It is part of the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) ecosystem and requires One Time Registration (OTR) for application. The scheme supports students with disabilities in accessing technical and professional education through direct benefit transfer (DBT).
objectives: Provide encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education
Enable students with disabilities to study further and prepare for a successful future through technical education/knowledge
Ensure financial assistance is provided to eligible students with disabilities for higher education
Promote inclusion of students with disabilities in AICTE-approved institutions and courses
Support students with disabilities in accessing scholarships via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
eligibility: The candidate should be admitted to First year of Diploma level course OR Second year of Diploma level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE approved Institution of respective year. Specially-abled student, having disability of not less than 40%. Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year. A valid income certificate issued by State/UT Government needs to be enclosed. The candidate should NOT be recipient of any of the Central Govt./State Govt./AICTE Sponsored scholarships.
benefits: Rs. 50,000/- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc. No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges etc. Scholarship will be disbursed only through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in the bank account of the student by AICTE. Student must have General Saving Account in his/her name (FRILL/Minor/Joint account will not be accepted). Aadhaar card and Aadhaar seeded bank account in the name of candidate is mandatory for submitting online application.
financial_support: Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationeries, books, equipments, softwares etc. No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical charges etc. After selection, the awardee will be paid scholarship through DBT mode on annual basis.
application_process: 1. Visit the NSP Portal using the link: https://scholarships.gov.in/ 2. Select the “Institutions” option 3. Click on the “Registration Form” option to proceed further 4. The User will be redirected to the “Scholarship Institute KYC Registration” page, wherein detailed instructions regarding Institute Registration will be displayed. The User will be required to click on “Continue to Registration” to proceed further 5. Upon cl icking “Continue to Registration”, the user will be redirected to the “Registration” page. 6. The user is required to enter the Institute details under the “Fill Registration Form” section 7. The user must enter the Institute’s UDISE+ Code, enter the CAPTCHA code displayed on the screen, and click Next 8. After successful verification of the UDISE+ Code, the system validates the institute details. If the verification is successful, a confirmation pop-up message will be displayed 9. After successful verification, the Institute Details page will be displayed. The following fields will be auto-populated based on the UDISE+ data: UDISE+ Code, Institute Name, State, District. The user must complete the remaining fields: Institute Address, State for Affiliated University, Affiliated University/Board, Institute Management Type/Nature, Institute Website URL. After entering all required details, user must click Next 10. Upon clicking “Next”, the user is redirected to the “Nodal Officer” page, where the details of the Institute Nodal Officer (INO) for Aadhaar authentication are displayed. The user is required to enter: Mobile Number (linked with Aadhaar), Aadhaar Number, Name as in Aadhaar, Date of Birth, Gender, Designation, Official Mail ID, Alternate Contact Number, INO Identity Proof Upload 11. The user must then enter the mobile number linked with Aadhaar and click on Validate Mobile Number. An OTP is sent to the registered mobile number. Enter the OTP received on the mobile device and click on Verify. After successful OTP verification, the system will display a confirmation message indicating that the mobile number has been verified successfully 12. Next, select the consent declaration checkbox authorizing NSP to authenticate Aadhaar details through UIDAI and click on Next to proceed. The system then verifies the details of INO details as entered by the user 13. Upon successful verification of the INO, the user is redirected to the “Institute Head” page. The user is required to enter: Mobile Number (linked with Aadhaar), Aadhaar Number, Name as in Aadhaar, Date of Birth, Gender, Designation, Official Mail ID, Alternate Contact Number 14. HoI is required to enter the mobile number linked with Aadhaar and click on “Validate Mobile Number”. Subsequently, the HoI must enter the OTP received on the registered mobile number and click on “Verify”. After successful OTP verification, the Aadhaar-linked details are displayed. The user must: Verify all details carefully, Select the consent declaration checkbox, Click Submit 15. After successful submission of HOI details, the system verifies the details and displays a confirmation message 16. Upon successful completion of the registration process, the system generates a unique KYC Registration Reference ID. The user is advised to note the reference number for future use. The registration process under Fill Registration Form is marked as completed. The page also displays instructions regarding printing, attestation, and submission of the KYC Registration Form 17. After successful biometric authentication, the INO can proceed to the “Print & Upload Registration Form” section. The system will display the current KYC status and will provide the option to “Go to Print & Upload”. Upon selecting the “Go to Print & Upload”, the INO is required to: Enter the KYC Registration Reference Number, Click on Send OTP & Print, Complete the OTP verification, Download or print the KYC Registration Form. After printing the KYC form, INO must: Affix the latest passport-size photograph, Get the form duly attested/signed by the Head of Institute, Scan the attested KYC Registration Form, Upload the scanned document in PDF or JPEG format. Note: Upload Requirements: File Format: PDF/JPEG, File Size: 50 KB to 500 KB 18. Before accessing the Approval by Head of Institute (HoI) module, the user must verify the institute details. Enter the institute's UDISE+ Code, Enter the CAPTCHA code displayed on the screen, Click Next 19. The Head of Institute must access the HoI approval module by entering the institute UDISE+ Code and CAPTCHA. The system will then display the current KYC Registration status indicating that: KYC Form has been filled by the INO, Face Authentication of both INO and HoI has been completed, The attested KYC Form has been uploaded, Approval by HoI is pending. Click Go to HoI KYC to continue. The Head of Institute must review the following information: Institute Details (having parameters KYC Registration Form ID, UDISE+ Code, Institute Name, Address, State, District, Affiliated University, Institute Nature, Website URL), Head of Institute Information (having parameters Aadhaar Details, Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Mobile Number, Official Mail ID, Designation, Contact Information, Photograph), Institute Nodal Officer Information (having parameters Aadhaar Details, Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Mobile Number, Official Mail ID, Designation, Contact Information, Photograph). HoI must click on “View Attested KYC Form” and review the uploaded KYC Registration Form carefully. HoI then must select the declaration checkbox and click on “Approve”. After reviewing the KYC Registration Form, verifying the institute details, and approving the registration request, the Head of Institute (HoI) completes the approval process. To finalize the request, HoI must: Enter the institute's UDISE+ Code, Enter the CAPTCHA code displayed on the screen, Click Next. The system validates the entered details and updates the KYC registration status. Upon successful validation, the KYC registration request is forwarded to the concerned Ministry/Department for final review and approval. 20. After approval by the Head of Institute, the KYC Registration request is forwarded to the concerned Ministry/Department for final verification and approval. The Ministry/Department reviews: Institute details, Aadhaar authentication status, Biometric authentication status, Uploaded attested KYC Registration Form, HoI approval status. Upon successful verification, the institute KYC registration is approved and activated on NSP.
required_documents: Disability Certificate (Disability 40% and above as per Central Government Norms)
Bonafide Certificate issued by the institution
10+2/equivalent and 10th Mark sheet for Degree Level
Shaheed Certificate issued by the Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces
Current year income certificate, explicitly mentioning that income of family less than 8 Lakh, issued by Competent Authority
Promotion Certificate in case of renewal
HSC/12th certificate (In case of Degree level) & mark sheet
ITI certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Diploma level) & mark sheet
Diploma certificate (In case of Lateral Entry for Degree level) & marksheet

caveats: If a candidate fails/drops out in subsequent year, he/she will not be eligible for further scholarship

The grant of scholarship is subject to the condition that the student does not receive any financial assistance in shape of scholarship/any emoluments, salary, stipend etc. from any other source during her/his course of study in the Institute. In case of receipt of any financial assistance from any other sources, the scholarship shall be discontinued and the entire amount of scholarship will have to be refunded to AICTE by D/Draft drawn in favour of “Member Secretary, AICTE” payable at New Delhi
Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Only verified online applications will be considered for the award of scholarship
Applications will be invited once in a year through National e-Scholarship Portal of the Government of India
The gap period between the year of passing the qualifying examination and the session of admission in diploma course should not be more than two years
